title: Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #03 (크리스탈+인어비늘+공작눈무늬+UV네온)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, two thick goddess braids — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming roughly an equal irregular organic share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. ruby crystal clusters growing directly out of her own skin, erupting in true three-dimensional relief, each facet casting its own hard shadow, BLAZING RUBY RED crystal points, VIVID GOLD mineral veins dominates zone 1. mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL scale formations, VIVID SILVER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow dominates zone 2. peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP BLUE radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief dominates zone 3. UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but sound wave cymatics formations in ELECTRIC GOLD and ORANGE glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight dominates zone 4. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft, diagonal or curving rather than a straight line, the materials interweaving and overlapping gradually across an irregular blended border a few inches wide, elements of each scattered into the neighbouring zone, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive zone specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
